mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu_linkage_notice (menu_path, unread_flag, trigger_count, last_trigger_time, read_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{menuPath}, 'Y', 1, NOW(), NULL, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unread_flag = 'Y', trigger_count = trigger_count + 1, last_trigger_time = NOW(), read_time = NULL, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT menu_path FROM sys_menu_linkage_notice WHERE unread_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY last_trigger_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu_linkage_notice SET unread_flag = 'N', read_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE menu_path = #{menuPath} AND unread_flag = 'Y'
